answer: Voting weight stays capped by verified stake, so one operator's clone farm can't outvote independent peers. First, a new agent must anchor to an existing staked member who posts bond exceeding fake-ID mint cost; seeding a sybil meadow gets expensive. Second, reputation flows only through sparse willow-like pairwise attestations, so self-vouching clusters grow slowly and stay visible. Clone rings pay real stake at the anchor or remain fringe foliage.
